reason: The bedroom wall is bubbling, so the house has to be done before next monsoon anyway. One company with a written price, a signed finish date, one person to call and the balance paid only after I check the work means I don't have to chase painters myself, so I would book the free visit and pay the 30% if the visit checks out.
objection: Bubbling usually means damp is getting into the wall. If the 3-year guarantee only covers the paint and they call any return of the bubbling a leak or seepage problem, then the guarantee is useless for the exact wall I'm worried about.
would_change_my_mind: If at the site visit they will not put in writing that the bubbling bedroom wall is covered by the 3-year guarantee, or they leave damp and seepage out of it, I won't book.
